완전한 '월클' 반열에 오른 국립중앙박물관부터 국립민속박물관, 국립부여박물관까지 그야말로 화려한 전성기를 맞은 K-박물관!

en-US.title: A country that is serious about records | Crab
en-US.description:
#KLAB #Museum #AnnalsOfTheJoseonDynasty #History

From the National Museum of Korea, which has fully risen to world-class status, to the National Folk Museum of Korea and the Buyeo National Museum, K-Museums are truly enjoying a splendid golden age!

Joining this formidable lineup is a new addition: the National Museum of the Annals of the Joseon Dynasty, which opened at the foot of Mt. Odaesan in Pyeongchang, Gangwon-do.

Despite its location being somewhat inaccessible, it is receiving a great response from visitors because they can view the original Annals of the Joseon Dynasty and Uigwe firsthand.

KLAB personally visited the Annals Museum, where visitors can experience the "power of records" of the Joseon era.

id.title: Negara yang serius soal rekor | Kepiting
id.description:
#KLAB #Museum #SejarahDinastiJoseon #Sejarah

Mulai dari Museum Nasional Korea yang telah sepenuhnya mencapai status kelas dunia, hingga Museum Rakyat Nasional Korea dan Museum Nasional Buyeo, museum-museum Korea benar-benar menikmati masa keemasan yang gemilang!

Bergabung dengan jajaran yang luar biasa ini adalah tambahan baru: Museum Nasional Sejarah Dinasti Joseon, yang dibuka di kaki Gunung Odaesan di Pyeongchang, Gangwon-do.

Meskipun lokasinya agak sulit diakses, museum ini mendapat sambutan yang baik dari pengunjung karena mereka dapat melihat Sejarah Dinasti Joseon dan Uigwe asli secara langsung.

KLAB secara pribadi mengunjungi Museum Sejarah, di mana pengunjung dapat merasakan "kekuatan catatan" era Joseon.
